title: Question on the page "rangeInput"
body:
Hi! I have a documentation issue on InstantSearch.js. I could not find what I was looking for on the page "[rangeInput](https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/v2/widgets/rangeInput.html)".

<!-- Describe what you're looking for here. -->
I have a requirement where I want to put a range of starting alphabets at top and depending on the selected value, the filter option get populated. 
To explain further, Cause we have many options want user to select 
Language
A-E F-J K-O P-T U-Z 
Once user selects any one option, then Languages will populate and then the filtered records will be displayed.

comments.body:
I'm not sure I completely understand the usage case with the `RangeInput` widget. 

From what I understood you want to display a list of languages `A-E F-J K-O P-T U-Z` where you can click on to apply a filter. To do this you have to put the language as an [`attributeForFaceting`](https://www.algolia.com/doc/api-reference/api-parameters/attributesForFaceting/) inside the index. Then in the front end you can now use this attribute with a [`refinementList`](https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/v2/widgets/refinementList.html). It displays the list of the available languages. Here is [an example](https://codesandbox.io/s/github/algolia/create-instantsearch-app/tree/templates/instantsearch.js) with a list of brand but you got the ideas.
Closing for inactivity – feel free to reopen.
